decision.rationale: About 41% less cold-build time and 70% less repeated-build time; accepts about 2% CPU microbenchmark elapsed-time cost and 4.3% executable size increase. Thin/16 has a repeatable 6-7% date conversion penalty. No claim of all-platform or tail-latency equivalence.
limitations: Single Windows host; one cold build and two complete rebuilds per profile
Engine harness excludes WebView rendering, full Tauri IPC, JDBC and remote network
Fixed O3 worker; its own profile is not varied
Parsing interval remains wide; JavaScript p95 is noisy and rose in confirmation
Results precede CI/Linux verification of the selected profile
